description: Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {chainId, to, data, value} plus `simulation` — an eth_call of exactly it from `from` (ok, or the revert decoded by name) — `warnings` and `next`. This server signs nothing: the sender signs and sends it with their own wallet and pays the gas. LPManagerFactory.createManagerNondeterministic on Base, Arbitrum, Unichain or Ethereum; `from` pays its gas. To create without gas of your own on Base, Arbitrum or Unichain, use quote_create_manager → create_manager instead (Envelop's relayer, paid in USDC; mainnet has no relayer). Anyone may send it; the manager NFT goes to `owner`. Either `strategy` (a Think Tank id: its template fixes product and pools) or `product` + `pools`. The pool set is fixed forever; the chain's price oracle is wired in. The new address is the `proxy` of the factory's EnvelopV2Deployment event in the receipt.

chainId.description: EVM chain id: 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 130 Unichain (1 = Ethereum mainnet, your gas)

from.description: Who sends (and pays gas for) the transaction; any address — the factory is permissionless and the NFT still goes to `owner`

name.description: Display name, up to 31 UTF-8 bytes

owner.description: Who receives the manager NFT. Explicit on purpose: a smart account on one chain may not exist on another

pools.description: Without `strategy`: the manager's pool set, 1–32, fixed forever at creation

hooks.description: Must be zero (hooked pools are not created here)

tickLower.description: Stable only: the manager's fixed range in this pool

strategy.description: A Think Tank strategy id (think-tank/<slug>) — its manager template supplies product and pools; chainId must be the strategy's chain

name: prepare_create_manager
title: Tx: create a manager
